ui_ctrl_move_desc: Walk left or right with responsive physics
ui_ctrl_jump_desc: Agile jump with variable height based on key press
ui_ctrl_dash_desc: Quick horizontal boost to cross gaps and dodge hazards
ui_ctrl_edash_desc: At level 4 charge (Mega Orb), press C or L for an electrified dash dealing 120 damage
ui_ctrl_shoot_up_desc: Hold Up or W while shooting (X / J) to fire projectiles vertically into the sky
ui_ctrl_shoot_down_desc: In the air, hold Down or S and shoot (X / J) to fire downward at ground targets
ui_ctrl_shoot_levels_desc: Level 1: Quick star (tap X / J) | Level 2: Light burst | Level 3: Plasma orb | Level 4: Mega Orb (enables Energy Dash) | Level 5: Super Cosmic Ray
ui_ctrl_beam_desc: Hold shoot to the 5th charge and release to unleash a continuous screen-clearing piercing laser beam
ui_ctrl_slash_desc: Close-range frontal melee slash in the Dark Hallway
ui_touch_dpad_desc: 8-direction virtual pad to move Peggy and aim in different directions
ui_touch_jump_desc: Tap to jump. Hold down for greater air height
ui_touch_dash_desc: Quick burst in the direction Peggy is facing to evade dangers
ui_touch_edash_desc: At level 4 charge, press the DASH button to unleash a charged dash dealing 120 damage
ui_touch_shoot_up_desc: Slide D-pad up and press shoot to attack aerial enemies
ui_touch_shoot_down_desc: In the air, slide D-pad down and press shoot to attack toward the ground
ui_touch_shoot_levels_desc: Level 1: Quick star (tap) | Level 2: Light burst | Level 3: Plasma orb | Level 4: Mega Orb (enables Energy Dash) | Level 5: Super Cosmic Ray
ui_touch_beam_desc: Hold the shoot button until charge level 5 and release to fire a continuous beam that obliterates everything in its path
ui_touch_slash_desc: Replaces action buttons during the dark hunt for melee cuts

All whom you once defied have risen relentless, famished for your agony — especially the monstrous beasts awaiting at each journey's end. Savor your eternal torment, while the agonizing shrieks and echoes of your slaughtered companions shatter your sanity forever...
